findings.claim: the area README promises a reassignment filter that spec 01 requirement 36 says does not exist and that requirement 42's closed filter sets could not express

witness.detail: specs/requests/README.md:84 — 'Member soft-deleted | user-management/04 | Requests they raised or hold are retained and readable; open requests **addressed to** them are flagged `assigneeInactive` and surface in the reassignment filter | 01'. Against specs/requests/01-requests.md requirement 36 — 'There is no reassignment **filter**: requirement 42 enumerates the filters exhaustively and this is not one of them, so a request needing reassignment is found by its banner and not by narrowing the list.' Requirement 42's filters are type (all|access|question|vacation), status (all|open|answered|granted|declined|cancelled), projectId and q, and an unknown value in either closed set is a 400 rather than a fallback (apps/api/src/requests/requests.service.ts:170-176), so a caller could not send the filter the README promises even if one were built. The README is the stale side: specs/requests/02-client-participants.md:160 defers to 'spec 01 requirement 36' for this exact behaviour.

findings.suggestedFix: replace 'and surface in the reassignment filter' with 'and draw the reassign banner and control on the row and the detail screen' — the behaviour requirement 36 and edge case 11 actually specify. Raised as a note, not a blocker: requirement 36 settles it in writing, so nothing in the plan is undecidable, but a human should correct the README before the next spec in this area is written against it.

findings.claim: the README says spec 01 adds 30 new keys to REQUEST_MESSAGES; the spec's own Error Messages table lists 31 and 31 are present in the code

witness.detail: specs/requests/README.md:135 — 'plus **30 new keys on the existing `REQUEST_MESSAGES`** (`packages/validation/src/index.ts:1746`, which already holds spec 09's 21 vacation keys)'. specs/requests/01-requests.md Error Messages lists 31 rows (createForbidden through emptyFiltered), and packages/validation/src/index.ts:1803-1833 defines exactly those 31. The cited line 1746 is REQUEST_MESSAGES' position at the base commit f06c7d8; it is 1771 at HEAD because this branch's own additions moved it.

findings.suggestedFix: say 31, and drop the line number in favour of the symbol name — a count and a line in a document that no test reads will drift again. No behaviour depends on either, which is why this is a note.
